llm.summary: This skill is a scoped teacher assistant that reads one named student’s learning records to draft a renewal report, with disclosed consent checks and limited writeback.

dimensions.detail: The skill is explicitly designed for mainland China Chinese K12 teaching contexts, including localized terminology and crisis resources; operators outside that context should localize before use.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package is Markdown, references, and JSON schema content only; I found no executable installer, dependency fetch, remote payload, or command execution path.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The artifacts require a specific student alias before reading records, prohibit cross-student scanning, list exact read/write fields, and require consent checks before parent-visible output.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistence is limited to writing this skill’s own progressEvidence entries, with deletion/export controls; it explicitly does not send messages, alter student cards, change authorization, modify course ledgers, or delete full student records.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill handles sensitive minor-student learning records, but that access is directly tied to its stated purpose of producing evidence-based stage reports and renewal guidance.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if your teaching workspace is intended for Chinese K12 use or you are prepared to localize language, curriculum assumptions, and crisis-contact guidance. Because the skill reads student learning history, verify that your workspace consent fields are accurate before generating parent-facing reports.
llm.findings: [SQP-3] expected: The Chinese-language and mainland China defaults are real, but the artifacts disclose a China mainland Chinese K12 scope and instruct localization for other regions, so this is a deployment-scope note rather than a security concern.
